question: To calculate the number of different genotypes in any allelic series the formula is applied:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: n x (n + 1) -> multiplication of n and (n + 1) -> result in a larger number -> 80% CHAIN: n x (n-1) -> multiplication of n and (n-1) -> result in a smaller number compared to n x (n + 1) -> 75% CHAIN: (n-1) / 2 -> subtraction of 1 from n -> division by 2 -> 85% CHAIN: (n-1) x (n + 1) -> subtraction of 1 from n and addition of 1 to n -> multiplication of these results -> 70% CHAIN: (2n-1) -> multiplication of 2 and n -> subtraction of 1 -> 80%
analysis: The formula to calculate the number of different genotypes in any allelic series is n x (n + 1) / 2, where n represents the number of alleles in the series.
